# Set Up 
```{r} 
#| label: set-up
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ipdw)

## Load packages and functions from setup script
source(
  here::here(
    "3-scripts",
    "1-functions.r"
  )
)

trg_crs <- "EPSG:6440" # NAD 83 Florida North 

study_area <-  st_transform(get_study_area(), trg_crs)

study_extent <- study_area %>%
  st_bbox() %>%
  st_as_sfc() %>%
  st_buffer(1000)

land_barrier <- st_difference(
  study_extent,
  st_union(study_area)
) %>%
  st_as_sf()

cost_raster <- ipdw::costrasterGen(
  pols = land_barrier,
  extent = "polys",
  projstr = st_crs(study_area)$proj4string,
  resolution = 100
)
raster::crs(cost_raster) <- st_crs(study_area)$wkt

dist_pwr <- c(
  0.25,
  0.5,
  0.75,
  1,
  1.25,
  1.5,
  2,
  2.5,
  3
)

max_rng <- c(
  5000, 
  10000,  
  15000,
  20000
)

chla_proc <- readRDS(
  here::here(
  "2-data",
  "processed",
  "chla_proc.rds"
  )
)

sal_proc <- readRDS(
  here::here(
  "2-data",
  "processed",
  "sal_proc.rds"
  )
) %>% st_transform(trg_crs)

water_temp_proc <- readRDS(
  here::here(
  "2-data",
  "processed",
  "water_temp_proc.rds"
  )
) %>% st_transform(trg_crs)

do_proc <- readRDS(
  here::here(
  "2-data",
  "processed",
  "do_proc.rds"
  )
) %>% st_transform(trg_crs)

turb_proc <- readRDS(
  here::here(
  "2-data",
  "processed",
  "turb_proc.rds"
  )
) %>% st_transform(trg_crs)


```

# Sensitivity Analysis and Model Fitting

## Chlorophyll-a (***DROPPED****)

```{r}
#| label: chla-sensitivity-check
#| eval: false

chla_sensitivity <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  chla_proc,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "mg/L",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng
)

## save distance power output for later reference
saveRDS(
  chla_sensitivity,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "sensitivity_test_chla.rds")
)

ggplot(
  chla_sensitivity$summary,
  aes(
    x = factor(dist_power),
    y = factor(max_range),
    fill = mean_MAE
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_MAE))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
  labs(
    title = "Chlorophyll-a IPDW Sensitivity",
    x = "Distance Power",
    y = "Maximum Range (m)",
    fill = "Mean MAE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("chla_sens_plot", path = here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "figs"), device = "png")

```



```{r}
#| eval: false
chla_ipdw <- ipdw_manual(
  chla_proc, 
  cost_raster, 
  10000, 
  "mean", 
  dist_power = 0.25
  )

plot(
  chla_ipdw,
  main = "Chlorophyll-a Prediction Surface \n(DP = 0.25 | MR = 10km)",
  sub = sprintf(
    "MAE = %.3f | RMSE = %.3f | Bias = %.3f",
    sal_stats$MAE,
    sal_stats$RMSE,
    sal_stats$Bias
  )
)

```

## Salinity (***FINALIZED****)

Test model sensitivity against distance power X max range interactions
```{r}
#| label: run-sal-sensitivity

## SAL

sal_sensitivity <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  sal_proc,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "ppt",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng
)

## save distance power output for later reference
saveRDS(
  sal_sensitivity,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "sensitivity_test_sal.rds")
)

ggplot(
  sal_sensitivity$summary,
  aes(
    x = factor(dist_power),
    y = factor(max_range),
    fill = mean_MAE
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_MAE))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
  labs(
    title = "Salinity IPDW Sensitivity",
    x = "Distance Power",
    y = "Maximum Range (m)",
    fill = "Mean MAE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("sal_sens_plot.png", path = here::here("4-tables-and-figures"))

```

```{r}
#| label: run-sal-model-after-fitting

set.seed(42) 

folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
        x = sal_proc,
        k = 5,
        size = 5000,
        selection = "random",
        plot = FALSE
      )

sal_stats <- ipdw_stats(
  sal_proc, 
  cost_raster, 
  folds = folds, 
  dist_pwr = .25, 
  max_range = 10000, 
  value_col = "mean")


sal_ipdw <- ipdw_manual(
  sal_proc, 
  cost_raster, 
  range = 10000, 
  "mean", 
  dist_power = 0.25
  )  

plot(
  sal_ipdw,
  main = "Salinity Prediction Surface \n(DP = 0.25 | MR = 10km)",
  sub = sprintf(
    "MAE = %.3f | RMSE = %.3f | Bias = %.3f",
    sal_stats$MAE,
    sal_stats$RMSE,
    sal_stats$Bias
  )
)

saveRDS(sal_stats, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "stats_sal.rds"))
saveRDS(sal_ipdw, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "ipdw_sal.rds"))
```

## Summarize sensivity and prediction results

```{r}
#| label: prediction-summary-stats

prediction_stack <- c(
  rast(do_ipdw),
  rast(sal_ipdw),
  rast(turb_ipdw),
  rast(ipdw_water_temp)
)

names(prediction_stack) <- c(
  "Dissolved oxygen",
  "Salinity",
  "Turbidity",
  "Water temperature"
)

prediction_summary <- global(
  prediction_stack,
  fun = c("min", "max", "mean", "sd", "notNA"),
  na.rm = TRUE
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    minimum = min,
    maximum = max,
    predicted_cells = notNA
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    units = c("mg/L", "ppt", "NTU", "degrees C"),
    cell_size_m = paste(res(prediction_stack), collapse = " x "),
    .after = parameter
  )

readr::write_csv(
  prediction_summary,
  here::here(
    "4-tables-and-figures",
    "tables",
    "prediction_summary_stats.csv"
  )
)

prediction_summary
```

```{r}
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: create-heatmap-figure

library(patchwork)

## Reusable heatmap function
plot_sensitivity <- function(data, parameter) {

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      dist_power = factor(
        dist_power,
        levels = sort(unique(dist_power))
      ),
      max_range = factor(
        max_range,
        levels = sort(unique(max_range))
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = dist_power,
      y = max_range,
      fill = mean_MAE
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_MAE),
        color = mean_MAE > median(mean_MAE, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "viridis",
      direction = -1,
      name = "Mean MAE"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "white"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = parameter,
      x = "Distance Power",
      y = "Maximum Range (m)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 12,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

## Generate individual plots
p_do <- plot_sensitivity(
  do_sensitivity$summary,
  "Dissolved Oxygen"
)

p_sal <- plot_sensitivity(
  sal_sensitivity$summary,
  "Salinity"
)

p_turb <- plot_sensitivity(
  turb_sensitivity$summary,
  "Turbidity"
)

p_temp <- plot_sensitivity(
  water_temp_sensitivity$summary,
  "Water Temperature"
)

## Combine using patchwork
sensitivity_plot <-
  (p_do | p_sal) /
  (p_turb | p_temp) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "IPDW Parameter Sensitivity Analysis",
    subtitle = "Mean MAE from 5-fold spatial cross-validation"
  )

## Display
sensitivity_plot

## Export for capstone
ggsave(
  "4-tables-and-figures/figs/ipdw-sensitivity.png",
  plot = sensitivity_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)

```

# Prep rasters for SDM

```{r}
#| label: create-template-for-aligning-rasters

r_template <- rast(cost_raster)
crs(r_template) <- trg_crs

r_mask <- vect(study_area) %>%
  project(
    trg_crs
  )

writeRaster(r_template, here::here("2-data", "sdm", "r_template.tif"), overwrite =  TRUE)
writeVector(r_mask, here::here("2-data", "sdm", "r_mask.gpkg"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Sal Raster
```{r}
#| label: prep-sal-raster-and-save-to-file

sal_ipdw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "models", "ipdw_sal.rds"))

r_sal <- rast(sal_ipdw) %>%
  project(
    r_template,
    method = "bilinear"
  ) %>%
  mask(
    r_mask
  ) 

writeRaster(r_sal, here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_sal.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

```
